headline: Kaszek Ventures Raises $650 Million Seventh Venture Capital Fund
summary: Latin American venture capital firm Kaszek Ventures raised $650 million across its seventh early-stage funds, taking its total capital raised since 2011 to nearly $4 billion.
why: Kaszek is Latin America's largest independent venture firm, making its fundraising cycles a key indicator of technology startup capital availability in the region.

impacts.name: Venture Capital Sector
impacts.why: Fresh capital allocation expands startup financing capacity in early-stage technology markets.
